record: DISCOVERY-002 — connectors/meta-ads-mcp/ pre-exists, contradicting the amended plan's Phase B obligation
opened_by: The Eye, on product-1 AMENDMENT-1 Phase A acceptance
finding: The authorized amended plan (§3 / AM-43 activation) states that at the Phase A head 'cli/ and connectors/meta-ads-mcp/ do not yet exist' and frames Phase B as 'add both directories'. In reality connectors/meta-ads-mcp/server.mjs ALREADY EXISTS on disk (raw sha256 sha256:df4e115c266ef77441d44eda4785fea1d497e1290165fa136e0bc10fb5a5234f) and the pre-existing verify-contracts (313/313) + test-inventory are GREEN at the Phase A head with it present. cli/ still does not exist.
consequence: The Phase B obligation is misdescribed: it is NOT 'add both directories' but 'add cli/ AND formally classify the pre-existing connectors/meta-ads-mcp/'. The plan's justification for deferring AM-43 activation to Phase B (that pinning it at the Phase A head would break inventory bijection because the dirs do not exist) is only partly accurate — it holds for cli/, but connectors/meta-ads-mcp/ already exists and is currently tolerated by the gates.
scope: Phase A is UNAFFECTED (data-only; accepted; gates green). This is a PHASE B obligation change.
ruling: The Eye ruled this must route through the required governance path, NOT be reinterpreted in-place. Per-slice/plan-change governance: a bounded successor amendment to the plan's Phase B obligation + TELOS re-authorization + a new/confirmed Eye grant are required BEFORE Phase B work (the same path DISCOVERY-001 followed).
does_not_affect: Phase A (accepted, merged-eligible via the E1 genesis bootstrap mechanism)
the E1 genesis merge IF strictly Phase A bootstrap and it does not encode this classification
